tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lta sgom 'bel gtam byung ba'i brjed tho yod// swa sti/ rang gi rdo rje'i mched po rnams dang 'bel gtam byung ba'i gnad brjed thor bkod pa/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin can/ /kha tsam min par snying nas nges pa'i blo/ /mi lus thob dka' nam 'chi nges med du/ /shes nas tshe 'dir phun tshogs blos btang nas/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad kyi/ /re ltos dkon mchog gsum la blo bkal nas/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub sogs lam la 'bad/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i nges shes kyi/ /byams dang snying rjes kun bslangs rang nyid kyis/ /dge ba gang byed snying nas 'gro la bsngo/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje zhi lhag la sogs pa/ /dmigs pa'i bye brag gang zhig nyams len kyang / /thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /kha tsam min par nges shes 'drongs par bya/ /kun rdzob byang sems bsgom tshul go bla bas/ /ma bris 'di ni don dam sgom tshul la/ /zhi gnas dmigs rten mi g.yo lus mi g.yo/ /mig gi rdzi ma mi 'khrab yid 'dzin med/ /de ltar mi g.yo yan lag bzhi ldan pas/ /bsgom pas g.yo med gnas lugs skye ba'i thabs/ /nyams kyi skye tshul mtha' gcig nges pa med/ /kun kyang ting nge 'dzin du lam du bsrang / /dang por rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba 'byung / /de rjes je phrar song nas rtog med dang / /yang ni thol thol skye sogs sna tshogs 'byung / /de tshe rnam rtog skyes kyang rnam rtog gis/ /bya byed mi nus gtad yal 'gro sogs 'byung / /zhi gnas rjes mthun skye ba'i rtags yin gsungs/ /de ltar 'bad nas sgom pas rnam rtog gis/ /rgyu ba chad nas rtogs med bde gsal ngang / /gang 'dod bar du bzhag par nus pa dang / /lus kyang bde zhing yang la bsgom snying 'dod/ /'di la brten nas lhag mthong bsgom pa ni/ /phyi nang chos kun snang mkhan rang gi sems/ /bag chags 'khrul bas med bzhin snang ba yin/

/bden par grub pa rdul tsam med do gsung / /bzhag na mi sdod btang na mi 'gro ba/ /mi dran dgu dran mi 'char dgu 'char ba/ /bltas pas mi mthong btsal bas mi rnyed pas/ /'di zhes smra bsam brjod pa dang bral yang / 'gyu tsam gsal tsam rig tsam gsal le bar/ /myong rig ngang la yengs med lhan ne 'jog /re zhig de ka dmigs thun sgoms shig gsung / /phyi nas brtag mkhan myong mkhan gsal rig kyang / /gang du'ang ma grub 'dzin med stong nyid blo/ /shugs kyis 'char zhing go tshul je bzang 'byung / /mjug ni bsngo smon bya dang de rgyun bskyangs/ /de ltar bsgom la tshul khrims dag pa dang / /dben par gnas dang dmigs pa'i gnad zin pas/ /yun ring bsgoms pas gnas pa brtan pa dang / /gnas mkhan ngo bo cer ltas spros bral dang / /mthong ba'i zhi lhag dbyer med zung 'brel 'di/ /da ltar rjes mthun pa yin mtshan nyid pa/ /sa mtshams mthong lam dag ldan skye zhes gsungs/ /des na ding sang sgom chen phal che ba/ /sems gnas cha tsam grub la phyag chen du/ /sgrog pa'i rjes su ma 'brang gzhung lugs rnams/ /gdams pa shar ba gnad kyi don yin gsung / /de ltar bsgoms pas dran 'di dag tshogs lam dang yang dag spong / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas sbyor lam bar du bgrod/ /de nas dad sogs dbang po stobs rnams kyis/ /mthong lam skyes nas 'phags pa'i sar slebs so/ /de nas byang chub yan lag 'phags lam sogs/ /sgom lam sa bcu'i rgyun mthar bdud btul nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa phar phyin lugs/ ༈ /gsang sngags bla med lam gyi rim pa ni/ /gang zag rab rnams dbang gis grol ba'ang 'byung / /phal cher dbang thob dam tshig ldan pas bsgom/ /thog mar bsgom bya'i don la sgro 'dogs bcad/ /zhib tu bsam pa'i go rtogs ban bun skye/ /dbang gi dus su dpe'i ye shes sam/ /de ma skyes kyang myong ba khyad par can/ /de rgyun zab mo'i thabs dang bcas te bsgom/

/gang de'i ngo sprod rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /dpe'i ye shes des ni don nyid kyang / /myur du 'dren phyir myur lam sgom pa'o/ /gsal stong zung 'jug dmigs med ngang du bzhag /yengs med skyong shes 'dzin med lam khyer shes/ /ltos med blo bka' 'gyur ba rang thog grol/ /nang nas yid ches the tshom 'phrang las grol/ /bden gnyis rnam dag bskyed rdzogs 'bad nas bsgom/ /de dang mos gus las 'phro la sogs kyis/ /rtsa khams 'dus pas bde sdug la sogs pa'i/ /nyams rnams gang skyes la dor byung rgyal sogs/ /bogs 'don gegs sel thams cad nges par bya/ /dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang / /nyams myong sangs rgyas sa dang ngo bo gcig /gsung ngag 'khor 'das dbyer med lta khrid skabs/ /nyams su blang bya'i gnad gsum rgyas bshad rnams/ /gsal stong zung 'jug de'i bogs 'don no/ /bskyed rim skabs su 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag sogs/ /lam byed sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa/ /zhib tu shes pa gal che nyams len skabs/ /rnam smin phung po sha khrag gdos bcas lus/ /de sogs phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun/ /thog mar 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyang / /de yi ngang la zab gsal gnyis med kyi/ /rten dang brten pa mngon rtogs ji bzhin bsgom/ /'di ni bdag 'dzin gnyen por 'gyur che zhing / /mi rtog skyes na tshogs lam chig rkyang du/ /mi 'chor rnal 'byor pa yi ming thob gsung / /'di yang bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i brjed tho'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ lta sgom 'bel gtam byung ba'i brjed tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
